reviews.text:
I used to take my dogs to Kool & Kute specifically to be groomed by Ileana, and when I found out that she had moved to Pet Avenue, we followed her immediately! She has always taken such amazing care of my dogs, and I wouldn’t trust anyone else with them.
Our experience at Pet Avenue has been absolutely wonderful. The location is extremely clean, welcoming, and well maintained, and the entire staff is truly superior. Everyone is friendly, professional, attentive, and you can tell they genuinely care about the animals that come through their doors.
Of course, Ileana continues to do an incredible job with my dogs, and they are always happy and comfortable with her. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing they are in such great hands.
A huge thank you to Ileana and all of the employees at Pet Avenue for making every visit such a positive experience. We are so happy we followed her here and have definitely found our new grooming home! Highly recommend!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had such a great experience at Pet Avenue, Ileana groomed all three of my dogs, and she did an absolutely amazing job. They all looked beautiful, clean, and so well-groomed when I picked them up. You can really tell that Ileana takes her time and genuinely cares about the dogs she works with.
What made me even happier was seeing how much my dogs loved being there. They were comfortable, happy, and well taken care of, which means so much to me. It’s not always easy finding someone you trust with your fur babies, especially three of them, but Ileana made the entire experience wonderful.
I highly recommend Pet Avenue and especially Ileana to anyone looking for a groomer who is caring and professional.

10/10 recommend Ileana from Pet Avenue! She previously groomed our pup Hermey for the last year or two and he's been so comfortable with her. We moved over to Pet Avenue once she moved, and they did a great job. Super cute haircuts, I appreciate how it's a smaller space and the dogs can hang out in the back, and it's clear they truly care about the animals - they all seemed very happy when I went to pick him up. Thanks Ileana!
